twin_model.primitives.base module

Base primitive class for SimPy-based building blocks.

This module defines the foundational primitive that all other primitives extend. It provides core functionality for observable emission and configuration management.

Bases: str, Enum

Simulation data collection modes.

Modes:

DETAILED: Full observables, every event recorded PRODUCTION: Sampled data at configurable intervals FAST: Minimal logging, critical events and KPIs only

Bases: object

Configuration for observable sampling and performance optimization.

This class controls how events are collected and stored during simulation, providing trade-offs between data completeness and performance.

Simulation mode controlling data collection strategy

sampling_rate

Record every Nth event (1 = all events)

aggregation_interval

Time window for aggregating metrics (minutes)

Event types that bypass sampling (always recorded)

buffer_size

Maximum events to keep in memory per primitive

class twin_model.primitives.base.ObservableBuffer(buffer_size=1000, flush_callback=None)[source]

Bases: object

Circular buffer for observables with automatic memory management.

Uses collections.deque with maxlen for efficient circular buffer behavior. When the buffer is full, oldest events are automatically discarded. Optionally supports flushing to external storage via callback.

buffer

Deque with maximum length for circular behavior

buffer_size

Maximum number of events to keep in memory

flush_callback

Optional callback for persisting data

total_events

Counter of all events seen (including discarded)

discarded_events

Counter of events dropped due to buffer overflow

class twin_model.primitives.base.EventBatcher(batch_window=5.0, batch_size=100)[source]

Bases: object

Batch similar events for efficient processing.

Groups events by type and time window to reduce individual callbacks and improve performance. This reduces the overhead of processing each event individually, especially useful for high-frequency events.

batch_window

Time window for batching (simulation minutes)

batch_size

Maximum events per batch before forcing flush

pending_batches

Dict of pending event batches by type and window

current_window

Current time window being processed

class twin_model.primitives.base.IncrementalAggregator(window_size=5.0)[source]

Bases: object

Incremental statistics aggregator for time-windowed metrics.

Efficiently computes running statistics without storing all data points. Uses Welford’s algorithm for numerically stable variance calculation. This allows for constant memory usage regardless of data size.

window_size

Time window for aggregation (simulation minutes)

metrics

Dict of metric aggregators by name

current_window_start

Start time of current aggregation window

class twin_model.primitives.base.MetricAggregator[source]

Bases: object

Single metric aggregator using Welford’s algorithm.

Computes mean, variance, min, max incrementally without storing values. This provides O(1) memory usage and numerically stable calculations.

Reference: Welford, B. P. (1962). “Note on a method for calculating corrected sums of squares and products”. Technometrics. 4 (3): 419–420.

class twin_model.primitives.base.BasePrimitive(env, config, sampling_config=None)[source]

Bases: ABC

Base class for all SimPy primitives.

All primitives must emit observables for discovery-based learning. This base class provides core functionality for: - Observable emission and storage - Configuration management - SimPy environment integration - Common event patterns

The observable stream is the primary mechanism through which the LLM discovers relationships and patterns without prescriptive rules.

emit_observable(event_type, details, severity='INFO')[source]

Emit an observable event with sampling and performance optimization.
